name: The Big Bang
see: A dot in the dark, swelling with each tap and shrinking back when the taps stop.
play: Tap the dot again and again.
after: The bang: a flash, then the dark, and somewhere in it one star twinkles.

name: Twinkle
see: The dark after the Big Bang. One star twinkles somewhere; each tapped star stays lit.
play: Tap the twinkling star, five times in all.
after: The stars fly past at light speed, the planet comes closer and the stars light up as it arrives. Visible light, Starlight and Magma are known.

name: Sunrise
see: The planet in the dark, the stars out, and a warm light glowing behind the top of the planet.
play: Tap the light, five times in all.
after: Each tap lifts the sun until it stands in the sky, yellow and without a face. Sunrise is known; Yellow is found.

name: The faceless sun
see: The risen sun in the sky, yellow, without a face.
play: Tap the sun again and again until its core lights.
after: Ignition: the face plops out with a smile, the sun shines at full light and the planet glows red. Orange and Red are found.

name: The spin
see: The lit planet, with Magma and Rotation developed. It can be spun by swiping.
play: Swipe the planet to spin it faster and faster.
after: The moon flies out and the spin locks; days begin. Crust can be developed.

name: The crust
see: The moon in the sky; Crust developed, the molten surface cooling.
play: Wait; the first tap on the moon finds its phase.
after: The crust sets. Cracks can be developed.

name: Cracks
see: The crust set; Cracks can be developed.
after: The first crack glows on the crust.

name: The first crack
see: A crack glows somewhere on the crust; Volcanoes developed.
after: A volcano cone rises where it glowed.

name: The first eruption
see: Three cones stand on the planet; Volcanic Gas and Eruptions developed.
after: It rumbles, then erupts: lava, ash, gas, and the land grows round it.

name: The first comet
see: Night, with Comets researched. A comet crosses the sky, its tail in the color of the ice it carries.
after: It crashes into the planet; its atom is found and the basins start to fill. Comets keep coming, one a night.

name: The thaw
see: A frozen planet; ice spots show where it can be chipped.
after: The ice melts into the first ocean.

name: Clouds
see: The ocean under the sun; Evaporation can be researched.
play: Research Evaporation, then tap the sun with the sea under it, a few times.
after: Each tap sends a ray that steams the sea; the first cloud plops out and Clouds is known; from then on the sun steams clouds up by itself.

name: The first storm cloud
see: Clouds drifting round the planet.
after: They merge into a storm cloud, which rains, snows and strikes by itself.

name: Tides
see: The moon over the sea at night.
play: Drag the moon across the sky.
after: The sea bulges under it and lets go as a wave; tidal pools are left on the shore. From then on the tides roll in by themselves.

name: The soup
see: Storm clouds and tidal pools.
play: Tap a storm cloud three times over a pool, or wait for its own strike.
after: Lightning into a pool makes the soup of life; the Seas screen shows it build.

name: Life
see: The soup nearly full.
after: The first cell; the Biology page opens and the species evolve one from another.

name: Land
see: Sea life; oxygen building in the air.
after: Plants go ashore and the land greens.

name: Dinosaurs
see: Green land, animals on it.
after: The dinosaurs; each night a body comes until one is caught.

name: The asteroid
see: Dinosaurs live; a body comes each night.
after: The asteroid falls and ends their age; mammals and birds take over.

name: Lucy
see: Mammals and birds after the impact.
after: Walking Upright: Lucy.
